results.summary: This design is a remix of the VGA Playground Checkers template that adds a non-linear offset counter to make the checkers bounce. It outputs VGA signals on the uo pins and takes five colour-adjustment buttons on ui[4:0]. The motion is created by a counter that starts fast and slows down, and the rearmost layer moves faster to create an illusion of reversed direction. The design is notable for its simple modification of the template to produce a bouncing visual effect.
